name: Agritech
targetResearchers: Plant scientists, agronomists, soil microbiologists, and crop geneticists working on yield, gene editing, nitrogen fixation, and sustainable inputs
useCases: Crop trait licensing from university programs
Field trial collaboration with ag-extension labs
description: The agritech industry commercializes advances in plant genetics, soil microbiology, and precision agriculture, much of which originates in land-grant university research programs. Companies recruit heavily from plant-science and agronomy PhD pipelines and rely on sponsored research and field-trial collaborations to validate new traits and biologicals. The closest academic ties run through agricultural extension labs and crop-genomics centers.
